item.title: Sierra Nevada Graziers: Potential to be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC)
item.description: Monterey Jack, Jalapeno Jack, Medium Cheddar, and Sharp Cheddar raw milk cheeses. Reason: Potential to be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC). Company: Sierra Nevada Cheese Company. Product type: Food & Beverages, Foodborne Illness, Cheese/Cheese Product.
